summary.text: The story takes place on Mirrodin, which Phyrexia conquers and renames New Phyrexia, with the Mirran resistance and a corrupted Karn at its center.
Karn's barked order of "Offense!" is taken by the Phyrexians as the command to begin the war on the surface, and Glissa and her allies carry it out.
Mirran partisans resist bravely but in vain, Koth sacrifices himself so a wounded Elspeth can escape, and Phyrexia is victorious.
